selector.rationale: Patient's history of HBV-positive HCC and elevated alpha-fetoprotein, combined with imaging findings of multiple nodules in liver segments and a right-flank soft tissue mass, support the diagnosis of HCC with extrahepatic metastasis.

rejected.label: Soft tissue sarcoma
rejected.why: Although a primary soft tissue sarcoma could not be excluded, the patient's history and laboratory findings more strongly support a diagnosis of HCC with metastasis.

rejected.label: hepatocellular carcinoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis is less specific than HCC with extrahepatic metastasis, as it does not account for the patient's metastatic disease.

rejected.label: Metastatic disease to the lung
rejected.why: This diagnosis is too broad and does not specify the primary source of the metastasis, which in this case is likely HCC.
